title: Learning ASP.NET Core
body: Today I practiced building a simple blog with ASP.NET Core Razor Pages. I learned how pages, models, and forms work together. I also practiced saving data and displaying it on different pages.

title: Why I Like Working With Computers
body: I enjoy working with computers because there is always something new to learn. Whether I am programming, fixing a problem, or setting up a system, each project gives me a chance to improve my skills.

title: RAM Test Complete
body: Finished testing the RAM today. Everything passed without errors, so the memory appears to be working correctly. Next step is putting the system back together and continuing with the rest of the setup.
